text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, a brand-new ramen shop caught my eye,
so I decided to check it out—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was Mejiro Ramonu.
In a ramen shop, of all places.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――...Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: Didn't expect to see you at a ramen shop.
It's rare to see you at a ramen shop, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The owner invited me, you see.
He used to be a chef at a three-star restaurant
that we frequented.

text_block_list.name: Refined Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
I fell head over heels, you see, for Japanese ramen.
The very moment I took a bite, I was utterly captivated.

text_block_list.name: Refined Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ramonu is someone who always offers her candid
opinions... That is why, fully aware it might be an imposition,
I extended this invitation."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-senpai actually came all the way out here
because of her deep love for ramen.
Man, I'm looking forward to this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, we couldn't help overhearing...
We saw the reviews on UmaSta and came to eat ramen too.

text_block_list.name: Refined Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"A crystallization of love, beauty, and bliss:
our signature 'Rose Ramen.' Please enjoy."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Straightforward noodles and broth!
Now this is the ramen of ramens!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It definitely lives up to the name "Rose Ramen"!
In the language of flowers, roses mean love, happiness, and beauty.
It feels like all of that is in this bowl!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? But the most popular item here is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Is this the extent of your love for ramen? I see. How disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-What could have displeased them...? The aromatic vegetable garnish is so elegant, almost like a French hors d'oeuvre...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...Maybe that's why. The ingredients are different, right? Compared to the most popular menu item."

text_block_list.name: Refined Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I am ashamed of myself.
I concealed my true love.
Please, give me one more chance...!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: âRamonu-san. The shopkeeper said, "Next time, I will serve true love." It seems they'd like to invite you once more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Refined Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I hid my true devotion.
Hesitant over whether it was proper to serve 'this' to Lady Ramonu..."

text_block_list.name: Refined Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, our shop's most popular dish:
'Mega Garlic Rose Ramen.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without any hesitation or reserve, the bowl was placed right in front of her—
and Mejiro Ramonu silently began to eat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes... So this is naked love.
The flavor of love, beauty, and bliss—stripping away all modesty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps inspired by the love in the "Rose Ramen," Mejiro Ramonu's running gained an even finer polish afterward.
